title: Appeal.
bodyHtml:
[§658J-24]  Appeal.  (a)  An appeal may be taken under this chapter from:

     (1)  An order denying a motion to compel arbitration;

     (2)  An order granting a motion to stay arbitration;

     (3)  An order confirming or denying confirmation of an award;

     (4)  An order correcting an award;

     (5)  An order vacating an award without directing a rehearing; or

     (6)  A final judgment.

     (b)  An appeal under this section may be taken as from an order or a judgment in a civil action. [L 2017, c 113, pt of §1]
